definition.scope: width only; no height/general-conditioning certification; no model/loss/default change
definition.transform: copy FP32 C then C[...,0] *= np.float32(alpha); model origin x=0; no recenter/renormalization

interpretation_policy.conclusion: condition response is not adoption or legal attachment certification; width cannot certify height response
interpretation_policy.embedding_zero: if actual known embedding is unchanged, record UNRESOLVED; no added perturbation or extra forward
interpretation_policy.endpoint_effect: RMS per-corner displacement / L and relative to RMS C_plus-C_minus displacement
interpretation_policy.exact_zero: report exact array equality and zero deltas; no invented weak-effect threshold
interpretation_policy.time: early small response is not by itself failure; interpret all times with final RAW/POST visual review
interpretation_policy.velocity_effect: RMS(v_plus-v_minus) / mean(RMS(v_plus),RMS(v_minus)); zero denominator marked NA
interpretation_policy.width_effect: X-coordinate quantile95-minus-quantile5 width response slope is descriptive, not required to equal one
